profile.name: UART串口传输组件
profile.description: 用于实验系统中的非实体软件通信组件，通过 UART 串口与下位机或控制电子学建立连接，并提供初始化、按地址写入、按地址读取和关闭连接等基础数据传输功能。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component used in laboratory systems to connect to lower-level controllers or electronics over a UART serial link, providing basic transport functions such as initialization, address-based write, address-based read, and connection closure.
